title: Roy Palmer's fast execution and Jack Carey
summary: They discuss Roy Palmer working in a steel mill, how he compares for speed to earlier players, and Jack Carey; Ridgley says he always stayed in New Orleans apart from boat trips.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
